    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    TypstConverter
    AsciidoctorJ converter for the typst backend: walks the Asciidoctor AST and emits Typst source.
    TypstConverterRegistry
    SPI registration of the typst backend, so any AsciidoctorJ instance with this jar on its classpath (the doc plugin, asciidoctor-maven-plugin, tests) can select backend: typst without programmatic registration.
    TypstPageSetup
    The page and furniture setup every IKE Typst document starts with: paper, margins with a binding side, running head (title on the verso, current level-1 section on the recto), folio in the footer, fonts, paragraph and heading rules, table and raw-block styling, and the helper functions the converter's output calls (ike-admonition, ike-koncept, ike-unconverted, …).
    TypstText
    Text-level Typst serialization: escaping for markup mode, string literals, labels, and the protected-span convention that lets already-emitted Typst travel through a text pass untouched.
